First, 18 weeks + 7 days = 19 weeks exactly (since 7 days = 1 week).  
19 weeks = 19 × 7 = 133 days.  

Subtract 133 days from 1508-05-31:  
May has 31 days, so going back:  
1508-05-31 minus 31 days → 1508-04-30.  
Remaining days: 133 − 31 = 102 days left to subtract.  

April has 30 days, so 1508-04-30 minus 30 days → 1508-03-31.  
Remaining: 102 − 30 = 72 days left.  

March has 31 days, so 1508-03-31 minus 31 days → 1508-02-29 (1508 is a leap year, divisible by 4).  
Remaining: 72 − 31 = 41 days left.  

February 1508 has 29 days, so 1508-02-29 minus 29 days → 1508-01-31.  
Remaining: 41 − 29 = 12 days left.  

1508-01-31 minus 12 days → 1508-01-19.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1508-01-19
